description: Find QRdx docs pages for a question or some key words: how a feature works, API endpoints and fields, limits and plans, the React library. Returns up to 8 pages, best first, each with its title, URL, path and a matching snippet. The docs are in English: search with English words. Pass a result's path to read_docs_page for the page itself.

language.description: Ignored. The docs are in English only, so results always come back in English. Accepted so that callers written while the docs were translated keep working.

query.description: The question or key words to search for, in English.

name: search_docs
title: Search the QRdx docs
